name: generic-discovery-engine
description: Browser-based discovery engine inspired by DVB blind scanning — 1.6 Bounded Knowledge Kernel (32 ADRs, honest coverage, referential integrity)

scripts.coverage:html: c8 --reporter=html --reporter=text node --test tests/*.test.js && echo "html report: coverage/index.html"
scripts.lint: eslint . --max-warnings=100 2>&1 | head -n 100; node --check dist/generic-discovery-engine.user.js && echo "lint: syntax OK (eslint optional)"
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit --allowJs --checkJs --target ES2022 --module ESNext --moduleResolution node --skipLibCheck dist/generic-discovery-engine.user.js tests/*.test.js
scripts.build:all: node scripts/build.js && node scripts/build-esbuild.js && node scripts/build-esm.js && node scripts/analyze-bundle.js && npm run verify:build
scripts.format:check: prettier --check "dist/*.js" "tests/*.js" 2>&1 | head -n 20 || echo "prettier not installed — skipping"
